features.title: Heritage-inspired wood
features.text: Crafted with solid Acacia wood, Ristova Sofa honours the quiet elegance of heritage interiors while celebrating wood's innate character. Each frame is a one-of-a-kind creation, showcasing the natural artistry that makes solid wood undeniably personal.

features.title: Softly tailored upholstery
features.text: Experience fabric wrapped in restrained luxury. The Ash shade upholstery offers gentle neutrality that complements any interior palette while delivering the comfort needed for extended relaxation. Meticulously constructed with firm yet plush cushions, the seating adapts beautifully to how you move and settle, promising both visual refinement and genuine ease.

features.title: Balanced proportion with mid-back design
features.text: The thoughtfully proportioned mid-back achieves a quiet harmony between support and spaciousness. Ristova invites unhurried lounging while preserving your room's visual breathing room, making it perfectly suited for intimate reading corners or modest apartments.

features.title: Artisanal rattan weave in armrests
features.text: The handwoven rattan armrests tell a story of traditional craftsmanship meeting contemporary aesthetics. This rattan sofa brings distinct character and undeniable warmth, allowing light and air to flow through while casting intricate patterned shadows across your space.

features.title: Enduring presence for your home
features.text: The combination of solid wood, handwoven details, and refined cushioning creates a sofa that feels both anchored in heritage and vibrantly present in everyday life. Ristova is furniture designed to be lived with, not merely admired.

name: Ristova 1-Seater Fabric Sofa With Rattan Weave Armrest
